item.title: NHDDC holds January meeting, discusses 2026 events, downtown planning, tourism updates
item.description: The Natchitoches Historic District Development Commission (NHDDC) met on Jan. 15 to review financials, plan upcoming events, and discuss ongoing downtown development initiatives for 2026. Financial reports showed the NHDDC ended December with $63,741 on hand and has since received over $150,000 from its 2025–26 appropriation. item.title: Natchitoches Rowing Club opens spring registration for juniors, adults
item.description: The Natchitoches Rowing Club is inviting new members to join its junior and master’s teams this spring. The club welcomes students in grades 7-12 for the junior program and adults 18 and older for the master’s program. No prior experience is required, as all participants will receive training from the club’s experienced coaching staff. item.title: Lane Closure: J.C. Deblieux Drive on January 19
item.description: The City of Natchitoches announces the closure of the outside (southbound) travel lane on J.C. Deblieux Drive, beginning on Monday, January 19, 2026. This lane closure will help to expedite completion of the concrete pavement replacement work on this street that has been ongoing for the past several weeks. item.description: A two-vehicle crash on La. Hwy. 504 at Hanna Drive in Oak Grove caused brief traffic delays on Jan. 15, according to the Natchitoches Parish Sheriff’s Office. item.title: The price of secrecy: Natchitoches taxpayers paid $69,000+ to hide public records
item.description: The final tally is in, and it’s staggering: The City of Natchitoches spent additional $57,636 in taxpayer funds to prevent citizens from accessing public records they were legally entitled to see.
